headline: Tech stocks swing on fears of AI regulation after midterms
summary: US tech shares fell sharply after the midterms on fears of tougher AI and data-center regulation, and the selloff spread to Asian and European markets. Outlets then differed on direction: some reported stocks climbing back after trillions in value were wiped out, while others still framed it as a possible AI bubble bursting.
